How to assemble and independently review a packet
  1. Add the exact text of each agreement version, invoice, and acceptance message. Keep the originals separately. PDFs and images need a text transcription for this prototype.
  2. Create a milestone and cite an exact, unique excerpt from each source. Choose the agreement version the acceptance record refers to.
  3. Import BCH output records, including transaction ID, output index, amount, recipient, and reported confirmations. Resolve reused addresses with a written note.
  4. Export the HTML packet and JSON report. A reviewer can inspect the included text, check excerpts and hashes, follow payment explorer links, and rerun the report verifier.

Fields and confirmation counts are supplied records. The app checks links and arithmetic; it does not authenticate identities, certify document origins, verify blockchain inclusion, or decide contractual liability. A checksum detects changes to supplied text, not who authored it or when.

Only BCH coin amounts are supported. At least one reported confirmation counts toward the balance. Pending and unknown counts remain separate. No exchange rates, token units, escrow, signatures, or legal conclusions are inferred.
